traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Originality that reads as brilliance or healthy independence. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: A chance to organize selfhood and disruption into a new form; it must be actively taken up.
cyclic.waning: Reorganize and share what selfhood and disruption have taught; communicate the insight.

business: An opening in this area. Suited to independent or innovative work where you aren't boxed in.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and instability for its own sake go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: A supportive opening becomes available; offered, not automatic.
arcSeparating: The opening closes; unused, it passes.
